label: Starship Integrated Flight Tests
delta: IFT-12 COMPLETED May 22, 2026 at 22:30 UTC from OLP-2. Block 3 debut: Booster 19 (33 Raptor 3 engines) + Ship 39 V3 (124.4 m). OUTCOMES: Raptor engine relight in space — SUCCESS (first ever); Ship 39 Indian Ocean splashdown — SUCCESS; 22 Starlink mass-simulators deployed — SUCCESS. ANOMALY: Booster 19 off-nominal boostback burn (outer ring Raptor 3 fuel pre-conditioning failure) → transonic ocean impact at ~1,450 km/h (not recovered). STATUS: FAA formally grounded Starship on May 27–28 pending mishap investigation — 6th Starship grounding. Root cause confirmed May 24; FAA investigation rationale detailed May 29 (Tesla Oracle / Aviation Week): outer ring Raptor 3 engines failed to ignite during boostback, triggering 14 CFR Part 401 mandatory review. Formal FAA review expected to resolve late June 2026. IFT-13 (Booster 20 + Ship 40) DELAYED from late June to July–August 2026. SpaceX may revert IFT-13 booster to Gulf splashdown profile rather than Mechazilla catch.
